contract_refinements.existing_invariant: A stable action identity and the exact proposal identity are distinct.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: prepared_action_reference has one reference_id and cannot explicitly bind both identities.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Add separate opaque action_id and proposal_version_id, with a labeled Nova-derived fingerprint fallback only when the latter is absent.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Institution-approved review profiles define requirements.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: The profile lacks normalized age, source, applicability, and revalidation rule structures.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Add versioned requirement structures whose absent or conflicting rules remain unresolved.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Mixed evidence environments preserve segmentation without promotion.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: A single record_source_type.value has no deterministic mixed-packet aggregate representation.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Define a mixed aggregate representation or make segmentation the authoritative aggregate with a deterministic compatibility value.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Source authority is scoped and conflicts remain visible.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: Source references have no standard authority-scope metadata.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Add designation_status, designated_by, applies_to, and authority_reference to normalized source references.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Semantic context material differs from proof-envelope material.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: The contract does not enumerate the two scopes.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Declare canonical semantic inclusions/exclusions separately from signed proof-record envelope fields.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Visible versions explain deterministic changes.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: derivation_version and canonicalization_version are not explicit response proof inputs.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Add both versions to reproducibility and proof material.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Digest validity does not establish source reconstruction.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: Reconstruction capability is not classified.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Add full_reconstruction, reference_integrity_only, and reconstruction_unavailable scope.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Review completeness is profile-relative and descriptive.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: The precedence among unavailable, conflicted, partial, and complete is unspecified.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Require an approved profile precedence and preserve evaluation as unresolved when no reviewed precedence exists.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Hashing is not redaction.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: Identifier hashing has no salt-availability or safe fallback rule.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Require an external scoped salt; redact when unavailable and prohibit raw fallback.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Prior chronology and memory do not create automatic applicability or acceptance.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: References cannot qualify treatment and current applicability independently.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Add treatment_status and applicability_status with unknown as a preserved state.

contract_refinements.name: canonical_numeric_and_interoperability_profile
contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Canonical semantic bytes must preserve exact interoperable numeric, monetary, temporal, Unicode, null, and ordering meaning.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: The design previously left number representation implementation-defined and did not decide how RFC 8785/JCS interacts with exact financial decimal semantics.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Adopt RFC 8785/JCS as the I-JSON structural baseline with a versioned Nova application profile: prohibit binary floats in semantic material; normalize exact integers and decimals to typed base-10 strings; bind monetary asset, coefficient, and scale; eliminate exponent notation; normalize negative zero; reject rounding and excess precision; fix UTC timestamp precision; preserve JCS Unicode; and declare array/duplicate semantics.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Cryptographic configuration is versioned separately from institutional action policy.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: No explicit cryptographic profile identity exists.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Add profile_id, profile_version, profile_hash, and verification_policy_version.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Digest identity includes its algorithm and parameters.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: context_hash and profile_hash are unqualified scalar fields.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Represent semantic hashes with algorithm, parameter_set, output_encoding, and digest.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: One semantic context may carry primary, transition, and renewal attestations.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: reproducibility.signature is singular.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Add ordered proof_attestations while preserving a migration rule for the existing slot.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Attestation identity includes an opaque key reference and key epoch.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: The signature field does not bind either.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Require key_reference and key_epoch per attestation without storing secret material.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Cryptographic operations bind explicit algorithm and parameter identity.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: Signature and digest parameter binding is absent.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Require normalized algorithm identifiers and parameter sets for every digest and attestation.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Proof renewal preserves semantic identity and prior attestations.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: No predecessor or renewal semantics exist.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Add renewal reason, predecessor reference, original hash preservation, and non-reapproval semantics.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Verification results are explainable under a named policy version.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: No verification-policy version is recorded.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Bind proof verification to an explicit verification_policy_version.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: A Nova clock value is not automatically trusted time.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: Timestamp fields have no time-evidence qualification.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Add recorded_at, source_type, source_reference, and verification_status.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Cryptographic integrity and reconstruction availability are distinct.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: Proof fields do not state reconstruction scope.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Bind each proof record to the G3-R07 reconstruction classification.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Cryptographic migration requires a dependency inventory without secrets.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: No cross-domain dependency categories are declared.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Record semantic, authenticity, confidentiality, access, supply-chain, and external dependency categories.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Unknown suites are unverifiable and downgrade attempts fail closed.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: The singular signature has no transition behavior.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Add unknown_suite_behavior=unverifiable and downgrade_behavior=fail_closed to cryptographic profiles.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Design work cannot claim implemented quantum resistance.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: No explicit claim-evidence boundary exists.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Require exact suite, scope, verification date, provider/library, and evidence before any quantum-resistance claim.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Digest migrations preserve one semantic byte sequence.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: context_hash is singular.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Support parallel algorithm-qualified digests over identical canonical semantic bytes.

contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Proof verification state is separate from context, source, and completeness state.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: No proof_verification_state object exists.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Add versioned verified, deprecated, unverifiable, invalid, and unresolved outcomes without cross-state mutation.

contract_refinements.name: semantic_identity_continuity_across_digest_migration
contract_refinements.existing_invariant: Semantic context identity is the canonical semantic byte sequence and its governing versions, not any one algorithm-qualified digest.
contract_refinements.current_schema_gap: The design did not define continuity evidence across successor digest algorithms or explicitly prohibit same-hash-value language.
contract_refinements.proposed_refinement: Preserve every historical digest record and bind parallel or successor algorithm-qualified digests to identical canonical semantic bytes. Verify continuity by the shared byte sequence and governing versions; do not replace historical evidence or claim different algorithms produce the same hash value. If canonical bytes or a verifiable preserved reference are unavailable, continuity remains unresolved.
